content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for MVH Junior Resident (MBBS) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Maharishi Valmiki Hospital (MVH), Delhi, to fill Junior Resident positions on an ad-hoc basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Junior Resident (MBBS) post under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the post name for these vacancies?
faq.answer: The available post is Junior Resident (MBBS) under the healthcare department of Maharishi Valmiki Hospital.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Junior Resident?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree from a recognized university, have completed a one-year internship not before 2 years from the interview date, and be enrolled with the Delhi Medical Council.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for general candidates?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for general candidates is 30 years, with admissible relaxations for reserved categories such as SC, ST, and OBC.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary under Pay Matrix 10 of the 7th CPC with a basic pay of Rs. 56,100/- per month plus other admissible allowances.

faq.question: Q7. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 14 October 2026. Candidates must report at the venue on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly Walk-in. Candidates do not need to submit any online applications prior to the interview date.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for attending the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their original educational and professional documents along with self-attested photocopies, identity proof, registration certificate, and passport-size photographs.
